fila1.descripcion: Graduates will be able to analyze, design, develop, and implement software and hardware systems; manage IT projects; apply engineering methodologies and standards; and communicate results orally and in writing in professional and academic settings.
fila1.textoExtra: Computer engineers can work in public and private sector organizations in software development, databases, networks, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, teaching and research, as well as in technology entrepreneurship.

fila2.descripcion: Applicants are encouraged to have a solid foundation in mathematics (algebra, geometry, precalculus), logical and abstract reasoning skills, as well as an interest in technology and solving problems using computers.
fila2.textoExtra: It is desirable to have analytical skills, teamwork ability, discipline for self-directed study, scientific curiosity, and a willingness to continuously update one's knowledge in a constantly evolving field.

mision.descripcion: To educate computer engineering professionals with a strong scientific and humanistic foundation, capable of analyzing, designing, implementing, and managing technological solutions that contribute to societal development, in alignment with UNAM principles and values.

vision.descripcion: To be a leading academic program in computer engineering education, recognized for teaching quality, engagement with industry, and contributions to innovation, research, and the training of professionals committed to Mexico.

valores.descripcion: Honesty, responsibility, respect, equity, freedom of thought and critique, commitment to academic excellence, collaborative work, and service to the university community and society.

paso1.descripcion: These are the certificates you have obtained throughout your academic journey.

col1.parrafo1: Throughout your time as a student, you will obtain each of the following documents for your eventual degree certification.
col1.parrafo2: The first four documents are required to begin your degree certification process.

filaInicio.botonEnviar: I want to submit my documentation!

col1.parrafo1: Documents 5 through 7 are required to complete your degree certification process; however, they are not essential to choose and carry out your degree certification modality.
col1.parrafo2: If you have any questions, contact the ICO program office.

doc1.texto: To obtain it, review your academic record/progress on https://www.dgae-siae.unam.mx/www_gate.php and verify that the term 11 completion label appears. The corresponding document is then used as support to continue your degree certification process.

doc2.texto: This is the official document stating that your social service has been validated and recognized by UNAM. To obtain it, you must first register where you want to complete your social service in UNAM's social service registration system at https://siassypp.unam.mx/, or visit the program office for guidance on internal social service openings. Remember that you must have completed at least 70% of your total credits; do not forget to bring your updated academic transcript.

doc3.texto: This is the official document certifying that you have reading comprehension in English. You can obtain it from the FES Aragón language center. If the certificate is digital, you must print it on colored opaline paper.

doc4.texto: The complementary training hours certificate is an official document certifying that the graduate has completed the required hours in extracurricular activities established by the study plan. You can obtain this document at the program office.

doc5.texto: The studies certificate is requested during the initial stage of the degree certification process, in parallel with modality registration and the academic record review. To obtain it, you must bring your academic transcript with term 11 status and 4 oval passport-size photos (3.5 × 5 cm) to the school services office.

texto.parrafo1: This is the complete high school studies certificate issued by any UNAM campus. It officially certifies your upper secondary education when you completed high school there.
texto.parrafo2: To process it or request information, visit the CCH campus where you completed high school or consult UNAM's school certification guidelines.

doc7.texto: Go to https://ingreso.dgae.unam.mx:8020/consulta_avance_sl to obtain the academic record review dates. You will need your account number and password for the SIAE-DGAE system. It is important that the specific dates appear through the tenth item.

modalidadTitulacion.intro: Explore and choose from the different degree certification modalities available to you at FES Aragón. Keep in mind that you must complete the modality you select in order to finish your degree certification process. Choose according to your interests and personal goals.
modalidadTitulacion.hintModalidad: Click on the modality you are interested in to learn more details

conReplicaOral.descripcion: Options involving a thesis, tesina or final paper and an oral defense before a jury.

tesisTesina.titulo: Thesis or tesina and professional examination
tesisTesina.descripcion: Individual or group thesis, or individual tesina, with an oral defense before a jury.

paso1.texto: Select a tutor previously approved under FES Aragón guidelines (Arts. 15 and 34). The tutor will guide your topic and the preparation of the written work.

paso2.titulo: Formal project registration with the programme office
paso2.texto: Register the degree option with the Programme Office once general requirements and those specific to this option are met.

paso3.texto: Develop an individual or group thesis (up to three members with programme office approval) or an individual tesina, according to the objectives and characteristics set by the study plan.

paso4.texto: Obtain the jury's unanimous approving vote on the written work and present the oral defense (professional examination). Then arrange scheduling with Student Services / Academic Secretariat.

actividadInvestigacion.descripcion: Incorporation into a registered research project and preparation of a thesis or tesina with oral defense.

paso1.texto: You must join a research project previously registered and approved by the programme's academic committee (Art. 13). Minimum participation is one semester.

paso2.texto: Submit a valid certificate (letter from the project lead, social-service completion/release letters registered for this purpose, or a certificate of professional practice registered for this purpose). The certificate is valid for one year to register this option (Art. 14).

paso3.titulo: Thesis or tesina derived from the research
paso3.texto: Prepare an individual or group thesis, or an individual tesina, with the content and characteristics the study plan requires based on the research activity.

paso4.texto: Assessment includes an oral defense before a jury. The project lead acts as tutor, or designates someone with the Programme Office's endorsement.

seminarioTesisTesina.descripcion: Final paper developed in the curricular seminar, with minimum GPA requirements and oral defense.

paso1.texto: Each applicant must have an overall GPA of at least 8.5 to choose this pathway (Art. 38).

paso2.texto: The thesis/tesina seminar must be a course in the study plan (required or elective) and designated for degree purposes. It must be passed in the regular exam with a minimum grade of 9.0; that grade is valid for one year to register the option (Arts. 41–42).

paso3.texto: Prepare the final paper during the seminar, approved by the course instructor. It may be individual or involve up to three members with prior programme office approval.

paso4.texto: Register the option with the programme office within the validity period and present the oral defense before a jury under the written-work-with-oral-defense modality.

sinReplicaOral.descripcion: Options assessed by a committee, with written work and no mandatory oral defense.

apoyoDocencia.descripcion: Teaching materials and/or written critique, with social service or practice registered for this purpose.

paso1.titulo: Social service or practice for this purpose
paso1.texto: You must have registered, completed, and been released from a social-service or professional-practice programme established for teaching support with the Programme Office (Art. 46-I).

paso2.titulo: Register within the first year after graduating
paso2.texto: Register this option within the first year after completing all credits in the study plan (Art. 46-II).

paso3.texto: Select a tutor previously approved under Art. 15 of the guidelines.

paso4.texto: Develop teaching materials and/or a written critique of a course or academic activity (bachelor's or upper-secondary), as defined by the study plan. The material must address a specific curricular need.

trabajoProfesional.descripcion: Verifiable related professional experience (at least two years) and a written report.

paso1.titulo: Two years of related professional activity
paso1.texto: From six months before or upon completing your studies, you must have engaged for at least two calendar years in verifiable professional activity related to your training (Art. 48).

paso2.texto: Include the employer's official government registration and an official employment letter or certificate. Work at different institutions may be combined if continuous, with gaps of no more than two months between them (Art. 51).

paso3.texto: Select an approved tutor and submit the written professional-work report with the characteristics required by the study plan.

servicioSocial.descripcion: Tesina on social service, activity certificate, and timely registration.

paso1.texto: Submit an activity certificate aligned with your field of knowledge, issued by the direct social-service supervisor, who must be a professional with a related profile (Art. 55-I). This item does not apply if you hold the Gustavo Baz Prada recognition.

paso2.titulo: Register within the first year after graduating
paso2.texto: Register this option within the first year after completing all credits in the study plan (Art. 55-II).

paso3.texto: Select a previously approved tutor for the social-service tesina.

paso4.texto: Submit an individual tesina on the activities carried out during social service, with the objectives and characteristics set by the study plan (Arts. 52–53). Assessment is by a committee (no mandatory oral defense).

articuloAcademico.descripcion: Article accepted in a peer-reviewed journal, derived from a registered research project.

paso1.texto: You must join a registered research project (Art. 13) and hold a research-activity certificate (Art. 14), valid for one year to register this option.

paso2.texto: Prove your participation (authorship or co-authorship) in an academic article accepted for publication in a peer-reviewed journal, acknowledging the project lead (Art. 58-I).

paso3.titulo: Register within the first year after graduating
paso3.texto: Register this option within the first year after completing all credits (Art. 58-II). The project lead acts as tutor or designates someone with the programme office's endorsement.

sinTrabajoEscrito.descripcion: Options without written work: external exam, high academic standing, graduate studies, or knowledge expansion.

examenGeneralCeneval.descripcion: Written exam from an external institution recognised by the programme committee. For Computer Engineering, EGEL (CENEVAL) is commonly used.

paso1.texto: You must pass a written exam administered by an institution external to the Faculty and recognised for this purpose by the corresponding programme committee (Art. 59).

paso2.texto: Obtain a testimony of satisfactory or outstanding performance as the exam result (Art. 60). In Computer Engineering, the usual recognised pathway is EGEL (CENEVAL); confirm the current institution with the programme office.

paso3.texto: The Programme Office approves registration of the option after validating requirements and, where applicable, convenes the oath-taking ceremony.

altoNivelAcademico.titulo: Full credits and high academic standing
altoNivelAcademico.descripcion: Minimum GPA 9.5, completion within curricular time, and pass on first enrolment.

paso1.texto: You must have an overall programme GPA of at least 9.5 (Art. 61-I).

paso2.texto: Complete all credits in the study plan within the standard curricular time (Art. 61-II).

paso3.texto: All courses or modules must have a passing grade on first enrolment (Art. 61-III).

paso4.texto: Register the option within the first two years after completing all credits. This deadline does not apply to those who graduated before the current guidelines were approved (Art. 62).

estudiosPosgrado.descripcion: Related UNAM graduate programme, with prior programme-office authorisation and first-semester completion.

paso1.texto: You must obtain Programme Office authorisation before entering the specialization, master's or doctoral programme to use this pathway (Art. 64).

paso2.texto: Enter a specialization, master's or doctoral programme offered by UNAM, related to your training or knowledge area, and approved by the programme's ad hoc academic commission (Art. 63-I).

paso3.texto: Complete on time the courses or academic activities of the graduate programme's first semester and meet the study-plan requirements for this option (Art. 63-II and III).

cursosAmpliacion.descripcion: Additional courses (≥ 10% of credits) in an extra semester, with exit GPA ≥ 8.5 and ≥ 9.0 in the extra courses.

paso1.titulo: Graduation within curricular time with GPA ≥ 8.5
paso1.texto: You must have completed bachelor's credits within curricular time with a minimum GPA of 8.5 (Art. 65-I).

paso2.texto: Pass additional courses in the same bachelor's programme or a related UNAM programme, amounting to at least 10% of total credits, with a minimum GPA of 9.0 (Art. 65-II).

paso3.texto: After meeting the graduation requirement, take the additional semester within one year, arranging enrolment with the Programme Office (Art. 66).

diplomado.descripcion: UNAM continuing-education courses or diplomas (≥ 240 hours), with prior authorisation and final GPA ≥ 8.0.

paso1.texto: Obtain Programme Office authorisation before entering the continuing-education courses or diplomas (Art. 68).

paso2.texto: Pass UNAM continuing-education courses or diplomas totaling at least 240 hours, as defined for this purpose by the programme's ad hoc academic commission (Art. 67).

paso3.texto: To register this option you must pass the courses or diplomas with a final GPA of at least 8.0 (Art. 69).
